storeHelp.helpRangeBody:
One range for every Store screen.
Pick a preset or your own days; today by default.
Days are always in the store's time zone.
storeHelp.helpHomeBody:
Totals add up real stores only: demo and shut-down stores never count.
One day: opening + sales − expenses gives the total at the top right; while open it is what is expected.
Several days: sales at the top right, with cups, expenses and how far the cash was off.
The pill under the name says how the day or days went; red needs a look.
storeHelp.helpStoreBody:
The same numbers for that store, with its latest orders.
See all opens every order in the range.
Day by day opens each day's cash and expenses.
storeHelp.helpFreshBody:
The numbers refresh every minute, or when you pull down.
Cups by day come from closed days, so a day still open can read low there.
